Private Function Say(o As Object) As String
    Dim s As String, v As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & ","
    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.Size

    s = s & v & ","
    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.TintAndShade

    v = "?": Err.Clear
    v = o.ThemeFont
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & v & ","
    Err.Clear
    Say = s
End Function

Private Function Fonts(ch As Object) As String
    Dim s As String, o As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Dim sr As Object
    Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
    Set o = Nothing: Err.Clear
    Set o = ch.ChartTitle.Font
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "title=E" & Err.Number & ";" Else s = s & "title=" & Say(o) & ";"
    Set o = Nothing: Err.Clear
    Set o = ch.Legend.Font
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "legend=E" & Err.Number & ";" Else s = s & "legend=" & Say(o) & ";"
    Set o = Nothing: Err.Clear
    Set o = ch.Axes(2).TickLabels.Font
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "ticks=E" & Err.Number & ";" Else s = s & "ticks=" & Say(o) & ";"
    Set o = Nothing: Err.Clear
    Set o = sr.DataLabels.Font
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "labels=E" & Err.Number & ";" Else s = s & "labels=" & Say(o) & ";"
    Set o = Nothing: Err.Clear
    Set o = ch.ChartArea.Font
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "area=E" & Err.Number & ";" Else s = s & "area=" & Say(o) & ";"
    Set o = Nothing: Err.Clear
    Set o = ch.Axes(2).AxisTitle.Font
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "axistitle=E" & Err.Number & ";" Else s = s & "axistitle=" & Say(o) & ";"
    Err.Clear
    Fonts = s
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Object, s As Object, r As Variant, t As String, v As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:D1").Value = Array("", "Rev", "Cost", "Rate")
    ws.Range("A2:D2").Value = Array("a", 10, 4, 1)
    ws.Range("A3:D3").Value = Array("b", 20, 6, 2)
    ws.Range("A4:D4").Value = Array("c", 30, 8, 3)
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 48, 360, 216).Chart
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:D4")
    ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
    ch.HasTitle = True
    ch.ChartTitle.Text = "Mine"
    ch.HasLegend = True
    ch.Axes(2).HasTitle = True
    Set s = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
    s.HasDataLabels = True
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which \ 60
    Case 0: Act0 which, ws, ch, s, r
    Case 1: Act1 which, ws, ch, s, r
    Case 2: Act2 which, ws, ch, s, r
    Case 3: Act3 which, ws, ch, s, r
    Case 4: Act4 which, ws, ch, s, r
    Case 5: Act5 which, ws, ch, s, r
    Case 6: Act6 which, ws, ch, s, r
    End Select
    t = "ok "
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = "": v = CStr(r)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    t = t & "|" & v & "|" & Fonts(ws.ChartObjects(1).Chart)
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = t
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    t = "Err " & Err.Number & " "
    Resume Answered
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
